logp.method_description: The logP values corresponding to the octanol–water partition coefficient were adjusted to the solubility properties of the compounds.55 Complexes were dissolved in water previously saturated with octanol at a concentration of 10-4 M. Into a 50 mL flask at 24 °C with a magnetic stir bar was introduced initially 10 mL of octanol previously saturated with water and then 10 mL of the complex solutions in water. The two-phase mixture was stirred vigorously for 10 min and samples, which were measured by UV-Vis spectroscopy, were taken from the separated phases. The values of logP have been found to be -2.19, -2.20, -2.80, -2.17, -2.20, and -2.75 for 1–6, respectively.
